server.bajaElRuidoYLaLuzDelLugarYAlejaAlUsuario: Lower the noise and light in the place and move the person away from whatever is upsetting them.
server.ofreceUnosAudifonosParaAislarLosSonidosD: Offer headphones to block out surrounding sounds.
server.apagaOReduceLasLucesYCierraLasCortinasPa: Turn off or lower the lights and close the curtains to reduce visual input.
server.hablaConVozBajaYFrasesCortasReconoceSuMa: Speak in a low voice and short phrases. Acknowledge their distress without arguing or correcting.
server.llevarloAUnLugarSeguro: Take them to a safe place
server.acompanaloAUnEspacioTranquiloYConocidoCo: Walk them to a quiet, familiar space with few visual stimuli.
server.ofreceUnMordedorUObjetoSeguroParaQueCana: Offer a chew toy or a safe object so they can release the tension.
server.siNoTieneMordedorOfreceAlgoSeguroParaMas: If they don't have a chew toy, offer something safe to chew.
server.respiraDespacioASuLadoParaQuePuedaSeguir: Breathe slowly beside them so they can follow your rhythm.
server.observaComoEstaAhoraYConfirmaQueYaNoCorr: Observe how they are now and make sure they are no longer at risk before resuming the activity.
server.cuidarElEntornoSensorial: Take care of the sensory environment
server.facilitarLaComunicacionDuranteLaCrisis: Make communication easier during the crisis

help.title: How Nubi supports you
help.goal: Nubi supports families of children with ASD in daily life: visual routines, calm, pictogram communication and help during a crisis. It does not diagnose or replace therapy.

sos.a: A step-by-step guide to support a crisis. You record the intensity and a possible trigger, follow the prompts, and it is saved for later review. It does not call emergency services: if there is danger, contact them.

network.a: The people around the child: invited caregivers and therapists, and trusted contacts to call during a crisis. Here you can ask for help and share reports with them.

professional.a: Nubi suggestions are guidance only and do not replace a specialist. Invite the child’s therapist from Profile, Network tab, with the Therapist role, and share reports for review.

answers.q: What do “I understood” and “I did not understand” mean?
answers.a: When the child taps a pictogram, the message appears here. “I understood” records that you got what was asked; “I did not understand” notes it so you can review that pictogram or phrase.

kidMode.q: How do I leave Kid Mode?
kidMode.a: Press and hold the “Adults” lock and enter your PIN. If you forgot it, sign out from that same window and sign in again with your password.

archive.q: What happens if I archive a profile?
archive.a: The profile no longer appears in Nubi and you can register another child. Its data is not deleted, but it cannot be restored from the app yet.
